choices.reason: The paper does not designate a primary novelty specification, so rule 2 favors Table 2's unadjusted randomized contrasts over Table 3's regression specification with incompletely specified covariate adjustment. Rule 6 resolves the remaining individual/team tie in favor of Individual AI versus Individual No AI, holding collaboration at its baseline (working alone); no pooled AI-versus-no-AI contrast is reported.
choices.locator: PDF p. 5, Methodology, Procedures, first paragraph (quoted factorial-design description); PDF p. 6, Data analysis strategy and Tables 2-3.
choices.quote: This design structure was selected as it enables the simultaneous examination of two central factors: GenAI availability (present vs. absent) and collaboration structure (individual vs. team-based)
